prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a new standalone square portrait for the named human Tao Zongwang (陶宗旺), for an existing Water Margin RTS character encyclopedia/HUD. Produce ONE portrait, not a grid or sprite sheet.
Input 1 (the 3x3 portrait atlas) is an identity reference ONLY for Tao Zongwang in the MIDDLE ROW, RIGHT COLUMN, approximately x786 y401 width414 height377 of the 1200x1200 image: the broad weathered human face with dark stubble/beard, gray-olive cloth headwrap, brown peasant work clothes. Do not copy faces from the other eight cells. Input 2 is the current Tao Zongwang walking-strip body reference for headwrap, tan-brown wrap clothing, strong working arms and the real IRON SPADE carried by that model.
Primary request: create a unified hand-painted historical Chinese portrait with a large readable face and the same grounded working-man identity. Robust broad human face, sun-weathered medium tan skin, thick brows, short dark beard/mustache, simple knotted gray-olive cloth headwrap, brown coarse woven wrap workcoat and rolled sleeve. No royal ornaments or fantasy armor. Exact face/costume is the game's visual interpretation, not a literal description claimed from the novel.
Canon: Chapter41 says he is from Guang prefecture (光州), from a farming household, accustomed to wielding an iron shovel/spade and very strong, also able to wield spear and saber. The nickname Nine-tailed Turtle is a metaphorical nickname, not anatomy. Show ONE ordinary solid iron spade with a wooden shaft, matching the WALKING MODEL: broad solid roughly rounded-square/tapering shovel blade, neck aligned with its long wooden shaft. Correct the atlas portrait's perpendicular HOE/PICK head into a true SPADE. No pickaxe, hoe, hammer, giant axe, turtle shell, tails, turtle jewelry, animal face, green monster skin or magical power.
Composition: close bust/shoulders, three-quarter view, calm alert determined expression. Face large and clear, centered with generous safe margins, headwrap fully in frame, face unobstructed. A modest recognizable shovel blade and wooden shaft can appear beside the shoulder, contained fully inside the frame, one natural hand may hold the shaft low; prioritize readable face at 64px and 32px. Do not stage an attack or add a new story event.
Style: restrained warm Chinese ink-and-opaque-paint illustration, dark controlled contours, modest textured brushwork, quiet warm parchment background covering the full square, soft even warm light. Avoid flat gray/white atlas backdrop, ornate border, text, labels, watermarks, symbols, glows or blood. Keep all essential face/weapon details away from outer 8 percent.
